visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins on an outdoor basketball court featuring green and blue painted surfaces. A young woman with dark hair tied in two buns and secured with colorful hair clips stands facing the camera. She is dressed in an oversized blue Golden State Warriors jersey featuring the Adidas logo and number 30. The setting is surrounded by lush green trees, and a basketball hoop stands prominently in the background under bright, natural daylight. (2) The woman smiles brightly and uses both hands to pull up the bottom of her jersey, revealing a dark blue or black one-piece swimsuit with circular cutouts at the midriff. She laughs and looks directly into the lens, showing a joyful and flirtatious expression. Her hands hold the jersey material tightly as she showcases the swimwear underneath. (3) She releases the jersey and it falls back down. She then turns her body 180 degrees to show the back of the jersey, which clearly displays 'CURRY 30'. She glances back over her shoulder with a playful smile and a wink. The camera remains static at eye level throughout this sequence. (4) A montage of still professional photographs starts, showing the woman in various poses on the same court. In the first still, she wears the swimsuit alone with high-top yellow sneakers, standing next to a purple basketball. Subsequent stills show her with the jersey draped over her shoulders or posing dynamically with the ball, maintaining the same lighting and environment.
